# Infinity Studio CR — llms.txt
# Plain-text facts for AI crawlers and search assistants.
# Canonical site: https://studioinfinitycr.com/

> Private operational English coaching based in Costa Rica, serving Latin America online. Not an academy — ORT, KPIs, AI coaches (Jill, Alice tutor, Alice Companion, Nexora), human trainers. Legacy brand: TU506 (Training United 506).

## Latin America (regional)
Inglés operacional para profesionales en Latinoamérica — entrevistas BPO, call center, trabajo remoto.
- Regional landing: https://studioinfinitycr.com/ingles-operacional-latinoamerica.html

- Free trial (no payment): Alice Companion only — https://studioinfinitycr.com/try-alice.html

## Alice Companion (premium product — free trial on web)
24/7 English practice partner — free-flow voice chat on any topic (work, travel, hobbies). Separate from Alice Nexus tutor in the student program.
- Free trial: 1 session/day, 6 messages — https://studioinfinitycr.com/try-alice.html
- Homepage section: https://studioinfinitycr.com/#alice-companion

## Methodology
- Nexus Method: Idea + Linker + Idea
- 5 operational KPIs: Idea Generation, Structural Thinking, Recovery Ability, Problem Solving, Responsiveness

## Para quién (target audience)
Infinity Studio CR is NOT an English academy. Private operational coaching for people who understand English but freeze under pressure.

Ideal profiles:
- Call center / BPO / tech support candidates — need to pass interviews and perform from day one → ORT
- Remote workers with international teams — meetings, stakeholders, fast structured responses → ORT + Nexora
- Weak foundation — academies failed; need communication core before pressure → Foundations (Jill 24/7)
- Already speak — need high-volume role-play without hourly cost → Nexora Professional (30 days 24/7)
- Daily confidence — talk about anything in English 24/7 → Alice Companion (trial: try-alice.html)
- Bilingual schools & institutions — ORT pilots for employability KPIs → contact for institutional programs
- Municipalities / public sector — youth employability with documented outcomes → Goicoechea case

NOT for: A1-B2 certificates only, cheap group classes, grammar-only study, casual conversation without work pressure.

Full page: https://studioinfinitycr.com/para-quien.html
LATAM page: https://studioinfinitycr.com/ingles-operacional-latinoamerica.html

## Success stories (documented)
Full page: https://studioinfinitycr.com/casos-de-exito.html

### Goicoechea 2021 (public sector)
- Municipal call-center readiness pilot led by TU506 (legacy name → Infinity Studio CR)
- Metrics (Informe de Labores 2022, p.34): 90 started / 10 confirmed hires / 15 in application / 25 still in training
- Official PDF: https://transparencia.munigoicoechea.go.cr/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/INFORMEDELABORES2022.pdf
